system.longDesc:
Area of Effect 15-Meter Radius

Instead of dealing their blast damage, smoke grenades create a colored cloud of obscuring smoke that expands up to 15 meters from the detonation point. Characters caught in the area of effect or trying to see through the smoke suffer a −5 penalty to vision-based tests until the smoke clears. The cloud dissipates after a number of rounds dependent upon the local conditions: 2d6 rounds in Earth-like conditions outdoors or in a well-ventilated room; 3d6 rounds in an area with poor ventilation or no atmosphere; or only 1 or 2 rounds under very high or low gravity conditions. In a well-ventilated area (such as a ship or space station), reduce the duration by 1d6.

Thrown: short range 4 m, long range 8 m (Accuracy (Throwing) test, TN 11).
